The football scoreboard is finished and handed in. It validates with no errors or warnings, and the reviewer found nothing that would keep it off air.

**How it looks:** a compact two-row board in the top-left corner, inside the title-safe area and clear of the pitch. Each row has a team name and a score cell, with a yellow line across the top. Long team names make the board wider but it stays in the corner. When a score changes on air, the number pops briefly.

**Your buttons:**

| Section | Button | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Goal | **Goal HOME** (shows the team's name) | Adds 1 to that score, puts a yellow band behind the row and slides a **GOAL** tag out beside it |
| Goal | **Goal AWAY** | The same for the other side; it replaces a flag that's already up |
| Goal | **Clear goal** | Drops the flag |
| Result | **Full time** | Clears any goal flag, turns the top line white, drops a white **FULL TIME** strip under the board and greys out the losing team (neither side on a draw) |
| Result | **Back to live** | Undoes Full time if it was pressed by mistake |
